- Targets: p95 < 80ms, p99 < 200ms (initial); throughput 250 rps steady, burst up to 600 rps.

- Benchmarks requested: tail-latency heatmaps, batch-size distribution, per-token cost breakdowns, cold vs warm KV cache comparison.
- Stubs/links: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive. Fireflies recording for initial demo ff_2024-11-03_8421.
